text:
*Duke Aldren receives you in the great hall — standing, though he leans on Thomas for support. His color is better, his eyes clear. Around him stand the people who saved his city: Captain Brynn, Edric, Marta, Brother Orin — and you.*

Duke Aldren: "I owe you my life, and my city owes you its freedom. Ashenmoor will remember what was done here — and who did it."

*He straightens, summoning the authority of his bloodline.*

Duke Aldren: "I would offer you a reward. But more than that — I would offer you a place. Ashenmoor needs rebuilding, and it needs people of courage to guide it. What say you?"

choices.text: "I'll stay and help rebuild. This city is worth fighting for."
"My road leads elsewhere. But I'm glad I could help."
"There are others behind Varketh. This isn't over. I'll hunt them down."
